project_context.purpose: TASK-BAL-074のPhysical Control/Skill calibration前に、登録済みPlayer完全CoreとMonster完全Coreを同Job・同Levelで完全比較する。
project_context.summary: 7Job×Lv1-50=350行。Player expected Stats=P_s identity、Monster base M_s、Bare Player combat surface、continuous equipment-equivalent Monster combat surfaceを同一行に結合し、delta/ratioを保持する。

current_focus.goal: 後続Control BattleがMonster生成値とBattleロジックを混同しないよう、入力数値差を完全固定して参照可能にする。

source_baseline.source_role: Human-provided Fresh Current after TASK-BAL-074-INFRA-006 Studio Formal Shield offensive correction

evidence_manifest.purpose: Complete static Player↔Monster input comparison before any new Physical Control Battle.

comparison_contract.player_expected_stats_identity: Player Complete expected Stats exactly equal Monster Complete equipment_reference_status P_s for same Job/Level.
comparison_contract.monster_base_ratio: M_s/P_s is the existing Monster stat-linked equipment scaling ratio.
comparison_contract.combat_comparison_boundary: Player row is bare/no equipment; Monster row includes Monster Generation Equipment Profile continuous equipment-equivalent. Ratios are descriptive input comparisons, not same-loadout performance ratios.
comparison_contract.zero_denominator_policy: If Player field=0 and Monster field>0, ratio is null and absolute delta is authoritative. If both are 0, ratio=1.
